Landing_MetaDescription: Roivo connects your bank accounts with AADE myDATA, reconciles transactions against invoices automatically and forecasts your cashflow 90 days ahead.
Hero_SubHeadline: Roivo matches your bank transactions against your myDATA invoices automatically, forecasts your cashflow 90 days ahead, and reminds you of every tax obligation before it falls due — not after.
Hero_Reassurance: No card. No install. Data hosted inside the EU.
Features_Subtitle: Two data sources that never spoke to each other, in one picture.
Feature_Psd2_Desc: Connect your accounts through Open Banking. Transactions update automatically, with no logging into ten different bank portals.
Feature_MyData_Desc: Sales and purchase invoices come straight from AADE's myDATA platform — nothing retyped by hand.
Feature_Reconciliation_Desc: Roivo works out which invoice was paid by which deposit, and leaves you looking only at what genuinely needs a decision.
Feature_Forecast_Desc: See where your cash is heading over the next three months, based on income and expense trends, open invoices and known recurring obligations.
Feature_Tax_Desc: VAT, EFKA, withholding tax, tax prepayment: an alert in good time, with the amount and the deadline.
How_Step1_Desc: Link your bank and myDATA once, through a secure authorisation you can revoke whenever you like.
How_Step2_Desc: Roivo pulls transactions and invoices every day and reconciles them against each other automatically.
How_Step3_Desc: You see 90 days of cashflow ahead, and the obligations coming at you, before they become a problem.
Accountants_Lead: If you handle 20 to 500 clients, Roivo shows you which of them is heading for a cash problem before they ring you to say so.
Accountants_Point1_Desc: One screen with all of your clients, each with a colour-coded liquidity signal.
Accountants_Point2_Desc: An alert when an upcoming obligation is not covered by a client's available cash.
Accountants_Point3_Desc: Portfolio-wide reports across your whole client book, ready to export and send.
Accountants_Mock_Caption: Illustration only. The figures are an example.
Pricing_Subtitle: Start free with one business. Move up when you need more.
Pricing_Free_Desc: For a single business that wants the full picture.
Pricing_Pro_Desc: For accounting practices and multiple businesses.
Pricing_Enterprise_Desc: For larger practices with specific requirements.
Pricing_Note: Prices are indicative and exclude VAT. No online payment is taken through the platform at this stage.
Footer_Blurb: Cashflow for Greek businesses and the accountants who look after them.
Privacy_MetaDescription: How Roivo collects, uses and protects your data, in line with the GDPR.
Privacy_Intro: This policy explains which personal data Roivo processes, for what purpose, who it is shared with, and what rights you have under Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and Greek Law 4624/2019.
Privacy_S1_Body: The data controller is [COMPANY_LEGAL_NAME], registered at [COMPANY_ADDRESS], VAT number [COMPANY_VAT_NUMBER], commercial registry (GEMI) number [COMPANY_REGISTRY_NUMBER]. For any data protection matter, contact [PRIVACY_CONTACT_EMAIL].
Privacy_S2_Body: We collect only the data the service needs in order to work:
Privacy_S2_Item1: Account details: name, email address, hashed password, account type (business or accounting practice).
Privacy_S2_Item2: Business details: legal name, VAT number, contact details, and — for accounting practices — the same details for the clients you add.
Privacy_S2_Item3: Banking data: IBANs, account balances and transactions, retrieved through PSD2 and only after you have explicitly authorised your bank to share them.
Privacy_S2_Item4: Tax documents: sales and purchase invoice data transmitted to myDATA (counterparty VAT number, amounts, dates, document series and numbers).
Privacy_S2_Item5: Technical data: IP address, browser type, access times and action logs, kept for security and audit purposes.
Privacy_S2_Note: We never ask for your e-banking passwords. Banking data is accessed exclusively through the official PSD2 interfaces.
Privacy_S3_Body: We process your data for the following purposes, on the following legal bases:
Privacy_S3_Item1: Providing the service — reconciling transactions and invoices, forecasting cashflow, alerting on obligations: performance of the contract (Article 6(1)(b) GDPR).
Privacy_S3_Item2: Retrieving banking data and myDATA invoices: your explicit consent and authorisation, which you may withdraw at any time (Article 6(1)(a) GDPR).
Privacy_S3_Item3: Security, fraud prevention and technical support: legitimate interest (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR).
Privacy_S3_Item4: Meeting our own tax and accounting obligations: compliance with a legal obligation (Article 6(1)(c) GDPR).
Privacy_S4_Body: To deliver the service, your data is shared with the following providers:
Privacy_S4_Item1: Enable Banking — a licensed account information service provider (AISP) under PSD2. The connection to your bank and the retrieval of balances and transactions happen through it.
Privacy_S4_Item2: AADE — the myDATA platform. We retrieve your invoice data from it using the myDATA user credentials you enter into Roivo.
Privacy_S4_Item3: [HOSTING_PROVIDER] — hosting for the application and database, in data centres inside the European Union.
Privacy_S4_Item4: [EMAIL_PROVIDER] — delivery of notification and account emails.
Privacy_S4_Note: We do not sell, rent or trade personal data. A processing agreement under Article 28 GDPR is in place with every processor.
Privacy_S5_Body: We use strictly necessary cookies for sign-in, session persistence and CSRF protection. We use no advertising or third-party tracking cookies. Any analytics cookies will be set only after your explicit consent.
Privacy_S6_Body: As a data subject you have the right to:
Privacy_S6_Item1: access the data we hold about you,
Privacy_S6_Item2: have inaccurate or incomplete data corrected,
Privacy_S6_Item3: erasure (the “right to be forgotten”), where no legal obligation requires us to keep the data,
Privacy_S6_Item5: data portability in a structured, commonly used format,
Privacy_S6_Item6: object to processing based on legitimate interest,
Privacy_S6_Item7: withdraw your consent for the bank or myDATA connection, at any time and without giving a reason.
Privacy_S6_Response: We answer every request within one month. Send your request to [PRIVACY_CONTACT_EMAIL].
Privacy_S6_Complaint: You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Hellenic Data Protection Authority (www.dpa.gr).
Privacy_S7_Body: Account details are kept for as long as your account is active and for [ACCOUNT_RETENTION_PERIOD] after it is deleted. Banking data and invoices are kept for [FINANCIAL_DATA_RETENTION_PERIOD]. Security logs are kept for [LOG_RETENTION_PERIOD]. After those periods the data is deleted or anonymised.
Privacy_S8_Body: Data is transmitted encrypted (TLS) and stored encrypted. Credentials and access tokens are held encrypted, separately from the rest of the data. Staff access is restricted and logged. In the event of a data breach we notify the authority and, where required, you, within 72 hours.
Privacy_S9_Body: Your data is stored in data centres inside the European Union. If any feature requires a transfer to a third country, it takes place only with adequate safeguards (an adequacy decision or standard contractual clauses) and is stated explicitly here.
Privacy_S10_Body: We may update this policy. Material changes are announced by email or by an in-app notice at least 30 days before they take effect.

Terms_S2_Body: Roivo is a web platform that connects bank accounts (via PSD2) with myDATA invoice data, reconciles the two automatically, forecasts cashflow, and alerts on upcoming tax and social security obligations.
Terms_S2_NotProvided: Roivo does not issue invoices, does not keep accounting books, does not file tax returns and does not process payments. Forecasts are statistical estimates based on historical data and are not accounting, tax, legal or investment advice. Your decisions remain entirely your own responsibility.
